title: [Audit] 🔐 Identity & Access
description: Who authenticated, how, from where, and what failed. Resolves the numeric user.name into real identities.

config.content:
### Who signed in, how, and what failed

See which sign-in methods and credentials are in use, your busiest people and API keys, every key and when it was last used, and each failed or denied attempt.

Use it to check that access looks as expected, review API keys, or follow up on failed sign-ins. Empty failure panels are good news. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Identity type, Identity or Client IP in the controls and set the time picker. Click an email or Principal id in a table to add a filter pill, which every page in the suite keeps.

- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown: an email, else an API key’s name, else the account name. A key named after a person is still a key.
- API key traffic has carried no email in this audit log. Kibana does not record which Elasticsearch key it was given, so those rows read “Unnamed key of” the key’s owner.
- Cloud API keys have no name or owner: tables show the start of the id, “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”, with Owner “Cloud organization”.
- A re-issued key keeps its name under a new id, so key ids can outnumber names.
- A failed sign-in counts once per attempt. Caller “Kibana dashboards · …” is Kibana retrying with an expired browser session, usually harmless. Credential type covers Elasticsearch requests only.
- The links above carry the time range and filter pills to the next page, but no dropdown choice: pick again there.

config.description: Distinct identities, all traffic: people, API keys, service accounts, user names tried in failed sign-ins, and placeholders for anonymous requests. The line above the number counts the API key names among them. Identity first and last seen lists each.

"Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS "incl. 1 key name", CONCAT("incl. ", CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) <= 3, TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(keys), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(keys), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(keys), LENGTH(TO_STRING(keys)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(keys), 3))), " key names")) | KEEP `Identities`, detail
